_about: Serene's own one-line summaries for specific ERA articles, keyed by ERA slug. update_era_articles.py uses these instead of ERA's description when present. Add more any time.

notes.freehold-rarer-2026: New freehold launches have dropped from 28 projects in 2022 to just 3 in 2026 — but the price premium over leasehold has also collapsed, from 48.2% in 2020 to just 7.1% today. See also my own take on what this means for buyers.
notes.ndr2026-housing: A round-up of this year's housing-related announcements from the National Day Rally — including changes to BTO and EC income ceilings — and what they could mean for buyers.
notes.singapores-emerging-estates-could-shape-: As URA's Master Plan matures new precincts and connectivity keeps improving islandwide, a handful of up-and-coming estates outside the city centre are emerging as ones to watch.
notes.15-month-wait-out-period-removed: Private property owners no longer have to sit out 15 months before buying an HDB resale flat. Here's a look at who this change affects, and what still hasn't changed.
notes.bayshore-drive-landmark-gls-bid: A record $2.13 billion Government Land Sales bid for Bayshore Drive may say as much about developer sentiment as it does about the site itself.
notes.lentor-profitable-sub-sales: Lentor's first profitable sub-sale transactions are starting to show what buyers actually prioritise once a newly launched precinct takes shape.
notes.upcoming-new-launches-2h-2026: A preview of the ten private residential projects expected to launch in the second half of 2026, adding roughly 3,600 new units to the market.
